title: Fence Wire Tensioners 30-Pack + Tensioning Handle – Complete Set
descriptionHtml:
Slack fence wire that animals get past?

Over time fence wire slackens, sags and loses its tension – and a loose fence keeps neither the animals in nor the predators out. Re-tightening by hand is heavy work and takes forever.

Tighten the whole fence – quickly and firmly

The set contains 30 wire tensioners and a tensioning handle that pulls the wire tight and locks it in place. You get a taut, secure fence around the whole pasture – without special tools and without wrecking your back.

Features

  • 30 tensioners + handle – enough for the whole pasture.
  • Tightens the wire hard – a sturdy fence that lasts.
  • Easy to operate – no heavy manual work.
  • Withstands wind and weather – for outdoor use all year round.

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
